## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or engineering result, not just the files changed.

## Scope

- In scope:
- Explicitly out of scope:

## Verification evidence

List the exact commands, checks, or real workflows executed and their results.

```text
<command or workflow> -> <result>
```

If an expected check was not run, state why instead of implying success.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe meaningful regression, migration, security, performance, or compatibility risk. Write `None identified` when appropriate.

## Documentation and decisions

- [ ] Durable docs are consistent with the change, or no durable doc change is needed.
- [ ] An ADR was added/updated if this changes a lasting architectural decision, or no ADR is warranted.
- [ ] Temporary handoff/active-plan state is consistent with the current repository state.

## Review focus

Call out the highest-risk assumptions or areas where independent reviewer attention is most valuable.
